Playable Replay — Phases 5–6

Open index.html after extracting the ZIP. Scripts, styling, scene and replay data are inline; no accounts, API keys or module downloads.
Observed-state preview uses tracked positions. Model replay is single-seed physics with recorded paddle controls.
Choose a reliable observed frame and Take over; mouse, touch and arrow keys control the paddle.
Return to footage ends manual mode. Export branch saves deterministic user inputs.
The learned model remains uncertain where training evidence is insufficient. Source positions and velocities are estimates.
report.json measures long-run replay drift against observed tracks. Future source ball/brick states do not drive manual play.
